# Feature request

Thank you for suggesting an improvement to control-TV.

Before submitting, please check that a similar request has not already been opened.

## Problem

Describe the problem, limitation, or use case that motivates this request.

What are you currently unable to do, or what could work better?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior or feature you would like to see.

Focus on the expected user experience rather than a specific implementation when possible.

## Affected area

Select the relevant area or areas:

- [ ] Device discovery
- [ ] Device selection
- [ ] Device status
- [ ] Media loading
- [ ] Playback controls
- [ ] Seek
- [ ] Volume or mute
- [ ] Desktop UI
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Installation or packaging
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Android
- [ ] Architecture or backend
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Device context

If the request concerns Google Cast hardware, indicate the general device type:

- [ ] Chromecast
- [ ] Google TV
- [ ] Android TV with Google Cast
- [ ] Other Google Cast compatible device
- [ ] Not hardware-specific

Do not include private IP addresses, device UUIDs, credentials, tokens, or other sensitive information.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you considered.

## Additional context

Add any other useful information, mockups, examples, or references.

If you attach screenshots, make sure they do not expose private network information, device identifiers, credentials, or other sensitive information.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues for a similar request.
- [ ] I described the problem or use case, not only the proposed implementation.
- [ ] I removed private network information and device identifiers.
- [ ] This request does not contain credentials, tokens, or other secrets.
